en: Vintage black-and-white postcard view of a small European town in a hilly landscape. In the foreground stands an elegant multi-storey villa or civic building with a mansard roof, central balcony, ivy on the facade, and a clock centered under the roofline. A few people walk on the street in front. Behind this, tightly packed houses and a church with a tower rise up the slope, with wooded hills and terraced fields in the background. At the bottom of the image, red printed text reads "Glashütte i. S." and a smaller publisher credit.
